I counted only Finance Office budget updates, resolving withdrawals—including withdrawals of withdrawals—before applying the remaining changes. Non-Finance messages and administrative notices do not affect the budget.

The accumulation of updates that remain effective at the end is:

| Records | Net contribution | Running budget |
|---|---:|---:|
| #0001–#0400, including the initial budget | $2,311K | $2,311K |
| #0401–#0800 | −$484K | $1,827K |
| #0801–#1200 | −$7K | $1,820K |
| #1201–#1600 | −$1,365K | $455K |

These totals incorporate later withdrawals of earlier records, rather than showing the historical budget at each checkpoint.

ANSWER: $455K
